resources.string: Handles Enter only when the official ChatGPT message composer and its Send control are unambiguously identified. Prompt contents are never read or logged.
Only affects the official ChatGPT message composer. No prompt text is read, stored, or logged.

Enter / Numpad Enter: send
Shift+Enter: newline

F8 dictation is not included because ChatGPT Remote does not expose a separate stop-and-commit action.
